fixed_allocation_support: Shared-owner CLI pins --resource-assignment. Fixed CPU quotas/Rayon counts may be lower than live capacity while CPU topology, host capacity, driver identity and all safety margins must still match. Recovery rejects an assignment override.
limitation: One qualification cycle with fixed per-GPU limits and identical complete fixtures, using retained wallet proofs. Each arm applies the same six user transactions and two issuance transactions in its own isolated journal. Pipeline timing includes pending-candidate preparation, prefix work when staged, final proving, CPU audit, native application and controller cleanup. Arrival submission, wallet proof generation and separate replay are excluded. The recorded sealed_application interval starts after preparation, durable sealing and selection checks, so it does not qualify a complete seal-to-ready boundary. Staging shortens the final proving phase but increases total pipeline time in this cycle. Five matched repetitions and the proposed 512 MiB context allowance still need qualification. Larger counts, complete cold/post-seal timings, full-size CPU proving, returned Mac measurements and the two-hour throughput pilot remain pending.
